name: gizza-ai/bip39-mnemonic-generator
summary: Generate a BIP39 mnemonic seed phrase

tool.description: Generate a BIP39 mnemonic seed phrase (12–24 words) from cryptographically secure entropy, with the BIP39 checksum word, and derive the 512-bit BIP39 seed. Optional explicit entropy_hex for deterministic recovery and an optional passphrase mixed into the seed.
